==Usage instructions==
Add {{Tl|TC}} to the top of the page to be deleted.

If the page has undergone a previous TC, you must come up with a name for the new TC discussion page using the following syntax: {{Tlp|TC|TC_page_name}}.

==Source==
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>
{{subst:iumb
| bg = #B0B0B0
| image = [[File:VoteOfNoConfidence-SWCT.png|135px]]
| caption = I move for a vote of no confidence [&hellip;]
| message = The future of Wookieepedia's coverage of this topic, including whether or not to delete or redirect this article, is currently being discussed in regard to [[Wookieepedia:Notability policy|policy]].
| comment = Please see '''[[Forum:TC:{{{1|{{FULLPAGENAME}}}}}|this article's entry]]''' in the [[Forum:Trash compactor|forums]] for discussion on the matter. Do not remove this tag until discussion is complete.
}}
</nowiki></pre>
